title_en: Near Zogut Te Black, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Totally Invested!!!
description_en: Near Zogut Te Black, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Totally Invested!!! The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a 6-story building with an elevator, built in 2010. The apartment has a net area of ​​116m², 22m² of common area and 35.5m² of veranda area, 174.4m² gross, the meters specified in the floor plan. The apartment is fully invested, starting with ACc5 parquet, internal doors, electrical and plumbing installations, thermal double-glazed windows, plaster work and spotlights, new toilets, appliances from the best companies. The property is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchen corner and access to the balcony, two bedrooms, one is a matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet, the other is a children's room and a main toilet. The apartment is a good opportunity for living as it fulfills all the necessities of life and the main facilities, as well as the tranquility that the area offers. The property is also a good investment opportunity as far as the rental part is concerned, as the area has many demands. The property has full mortgage documentation.
